from rich.console import Console
from rich.padding import Padding
from rich.text import Text
from rich.segment import Segment

def test_padding_overflow():
    console = Console(width=10)
    # Inner renderable that produces at least one line
    inner = Text("foo")
    # Padding that exceeds max_width
    # max_width for inner will be 10 - 6 - 6 = -2 -> 0
    # But if we set console width to 20, and padding to 12 each side
    # max_width for inner = 20 - 12 - 12 = -4 -> 0
    # Let's use a smaller padding that still overflows
    padding = Padding(inner, left=6, right=6)
    
    # We want to see if the resulting lines exceed console.width
    # We can use console.render_lines to get the segments
    lines = console.render_lines(padding)
    
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        line_width = sum(len(segment.text) for segment in line)
        print(f"Line {i} width: {line_width}")
        if line_width > console.width:
            print(f"OVERFLOW DETECTED: {line_width} > {console.width}")
            return True
    
    print("No overflow detected.")
    return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if test_padding_overflow():
        print("Bug reproduced!")
    else:
        print("Bug not reproduced.")
